title: Thermal cycling + mobility rehearsal
summary: Find arid, low-vegetation terrain with high diurnal air ΔT and traversable slopes for rover thermal and wheel/surface checkout under Earth gravity — then document what does not transfer to Moon/Mars.
earthLimitsAlways: Earth gravity ≠ Moon (1/6 g) or Mars (~0.38 g)
Earth atmosphere and radiation environment do not transfer
Biosphere and contamination constraints are Earth-unique
No Earth surface reaches Diviner-class ~40 K PSR cold-trap temperatures
Temperature comparisons must stay air↔air (POWER T2M vs MEDA) or ground↔ground (MODIS LST vs rover TIRS) — never mix without labeling
